sim:1:Legitimate relayer forwards the deposit proof to the destination chain in faithful mode.
sim:2:Honest user locks 1,000 tokens, emitting Deposit event with depositId=0xabc and nonce=0x1.
sim:3:Relayer calls mint on the destination token using the proof; nonce 0x1 is recorded as processed.
sim:4:Attacker re‑sends the same proof via a compromised relayer (replay mode).
sim:5:Mint is invoked again with the same nonce; because the contract does not enforce the !processedNonce[nonce] check, the second mint succeeds.
